title: POSITIONS_BALANCES_MARGIN — fill→balance reflection lag

args.note: P0-2 T2 wave-3 order session 2026-07-31 (post mock-account reset), stock leg. Mock stock creds (account 50187672-01) sourced from outside the repo at ~/.config/kis-probes/p11-mock-stock.env; the .env stock key is REAL and was not touched. Runs CONCURRENTLY with the futures P-FQP leg deliberately: a different app key and account, so the two do not share the rate budget P-13 measured. Now a 시장가 order by default (a marketable LIMIT was accepted but never filled yesterday — P-11-20260730T002715Z censored), and after the account reset the baseline holding should be 0. A fill leaves a position: the probe does not flatten it.

limit_price_tick.tick_source: NOT APPLICABLE — this run sent a 시장가 order (ORD_DVSN=01), which carries no limit price. No 호가단위 was requested and none was used: the inquire-price quote call was skipped entirely, so nothing here came from a tick table.
limit_price_tick.rounding_rationale: no snapping was attempted — there is no price to snap. Bypassing the tick machinery also removes its failure mode: a 시장가 order cannot be rejected with 호가단위 오류, and a broker that does not report output.aspr_unit can no longer block this probe.

fill_case.basis: inquire-balance (VTTC8434R) holdings are the ONLY fill evidence this harness collects; it has no execution-inquiry path.
fill_case.interpretation: the 005930 holding stayed at 1 for the whole 120.0s window. This run CANNOT tell whether (a) the order never filled, or (b) it filled and the balance reflection lagged past the window — the balance reports the same thing in both cases. No bound may be derived from this run under either reading.
fill_case.resolves_with: A stock execution inquiry — 주식일별주문체결조회, /uapi/domestic-stock/v1/trading/inquire-daily-ccld (real TTTC8001R / mock VTTC8001R) — would separate the two by reporting filled quantity for the ODNO directly. This harness deliberately does not add that trading-namespace path. Until it does, resolve out of band: re-read the balance after the run and see whether the holding ever moved. Artifact P-11-20260730T002715Z needed exactly that manual re-check (~18 min later, holding unchanged at the baseline) to establish that its CENSORED result was a NON-FILL and not a reflection lag.

measurements.position_left_open: symbol=005930 qty=1 — the probe does NOT flatten the position. Close it manually on 모의투자.

errors: balance never reflected the order within the timeout — CENSORED. Do not record a bound from a censored trial.
